Issue 4666 -- per-release matrix.

Generated by measure-history.py, which is committed beside this file.
Every '$' line is subprocess.list2cmdline(argv) for the process that was
actually launched, not a transcription. cwd is the issue directory.

Columns: <case> <status> exit=<hex> | first diagnostic line

A release is valid evidence about symptom A only if ctl-struct-first is
'ok' on it: that control is repro.hlsl plus an unreferenced
'struct Resources { SamplerState Samplers[2]; };'. If both fail, the
release does not support sampler-array parameters in any form and its
error is not the reported defect. Likewise ctl-spirv-noinline-plain-Vd
gates symptom B: it must not merely compile, it must show
'%Test = OpTypeStruct', proving the release materialises the struct type
at all.

SELF-TEST

The matrix reads its own output, so it has to be able to say 'nothing
matched' distinctly from 'nothing to match'. These counters make a
broken reader loud instead of quietly clean:

  BAD-IR-EMITTED             19
  CONTROL-FAILED             4
  CONTROL-NOT-MATERIALISED   1
  OTHER-FAILURE              2
  SYMPTOM-A                  16
  SYMPTOM-B                  18
  no-bad-ir                  1
  ok                         170
